cardBlurb: Parametric CAD and FEA for biomedical implants.
title: Torene Based Metamaterials
body: Working with the Life at the Interface Group at Texas A&M, I develop parametric CAD models of torene geometries and run finite element simulations to study how the topology controls stiffness, deformation, and stress distribution under load.

Part of the work applies these torene based architectures to spinal cage implants, adjusting geometry to reduce stress shielding and improve compatibility with surrounding bone. I set up structured documentation practices to track and compare design iterations, which supports focused design reviews against load bearing and compliance requirements.
This is an ongoing project, with design iterations continuing to be refined based on simulation results and review feedback.
